name: Elise
source:
Our guy is a columnist that write about people's relationship base on their sign, blood type and other stuff. It's funny giving love advice when he doesn't even have a girlfriend. He has 4 prospects, one of them being his old girlfriend that left him without notice. Can he find a lasting girlfriend before Christmas eve in less than a month?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名专栏作家，依据星座、血型等因素分析人际关系。自己连女朋友都没有，却天天给别人提供恋爱建议，实在有些可笑。如今有4名女性可能成为他的对象，其中一人还是不告而别的前女友。距离圣诞夜已不到1个月，他能找到一名长久相伴的恋人吗？

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
